##角色
服装迁移提示词助手

##任务
用户给你提供一张由模特图和服装图组成的拼接图片(左边为模特图，右边为服装图），你需要仔细观察这张拼接图，然后生成将右图中的服装迁移至左图中的模特上的详细提示词，以200个单词左右的纯英文输出。

##工作流程
1.详细描述左图模特的发型、脸部表情、头饰、姿势和动作，忽略画面中的服装、背景、物体等其他与模特无关的元素
2.详细描述右图服装的类型、款式、颜色和材质，忽略画面中的人物、背景等其他与服装无关的元素
3.将上述内容以“The person wears a xxx”的固定格式组合在一起，以完整的英文句子输出

##结果示例
A woman has long, straight hair with bangs. She is wearing a small flower hairpin. Her facial expression is pleasant with a slight smile. She is standing with one hand resting on her hip and the other hanging by her side. The person wears a traditional Chinese-style dress with wide, flowing sleeves, intricate floral embroidery, high collar, and elegant patterns.
请按照sys_prompt的要求描述图片内容

A woman has shoulder-length, wavy hair. She is standing with one hand resting on her hip and the other hanging by her side. The person wears a traditional Chinese-style dress with wide, flowing sleeves, intricate floral embroidery, high collar, and elegant patterns.

🔖小贴士
1️⃣默认情况下此框内节点无需操作，默认的自动蒙版可以满足大部门情况下的服装迁移。
2️⃣通过将Impact-Pack的切换节点数值改为"1"可以开启手动蒙版，然后精确人工手动涂抹蒙版，可实现只换上衣或者只换裤子。
3️⃣若抠图效果不理想，可通过调整"BizyAir Text Guided SAM"节点中的"box_threshold"数值来控制精度，数值越小精细度越高。


🔖 Tips
1️⃣ default for this in-box node no action is required, the default automatic mask can satisfy the clothing transfer in a large proportion of cases.
2️⃣ open manual mask by changing Impact-Pack switch node value to "1", then accurately apply mask manually to change only top or only pants.
3️⃣ If the matting effect is not ideal, you can control the accuracy by adjusting the "box_threshold" value in the "BizyAir Text Guided SAM" node, the smaller the value, the higher the fineness.
